description_en: Queries the network availability status of a phone number
name: MobileOnlineStatus

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: not encrypted.
md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密。
md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The phone number. Valid values:

If paramType is set to normal, pass in the phone number in plaintext.
If paramType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted phone number
parameters.help_zh:
手机号：

paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文
parameters.name: mobile

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:

1: active and available. 
2: not in an active and available state. For more information, see subCode.
3: no query result
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果

1: 在网可用 
2: 非在网可用状态（详见subCode）
3: 无查询结果

IspName.description_en:
The name of the telecommunications service provider. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile. 
CUCC: China Unicom. 
CTCC: China Telecom
IspName.description_zh:
运营商名称

CMCC：移动 
CUCC：联通 
CTCC：电信

SubCode.description_en:
The verification details. Valid values:

101: active and available. 
201: suspended. 
202: canceled. 
203: active but unavailable. 
204: not active. 
301: no record found
SubCode.description_zh:
核验详情

101:在网可用 
201:停机 
202:销号 
203:在网但不可用 
204:不在网 
301:查无记录
